title: Group Room Blocks Deposit Schedule
content:
Group Room Blocks deposits are set per block type. The signing deposit percentage is a percentage of anticipated room revenue, which is the contracted room nights times the group rate; the interim deposit percentage is likewise a percentage of anticipated room revenue, and the interim deposit falls due a set number of calendar days before arrival.

| Block type | Signing deposit (% of anticipated room revenue) | Interim deposit percentage (%) | Interim deposit due (calendar days before arrival) | Deposits refunded on cancellation | Deposits applied after the event to |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Social Event Room Block | 15 | 25 | 90 | No | the group master account |
| Wedding Room Block | 10 | 25 | 120 | No | the group master account |
| Sports Team Room Block | 10 | 0 | 0 | No | the group master account |
| Tour & Travel Series Block | 0 | 0 | 0 | No | the group master account |
| Corporate Meeting Room Block | 0 | 0 | 0 | No | the group master account |
| Association Convention Room Block | 0 | 0 | 0 | No | the group master account |

### Notes to the schedule

- The interim due column shows 0 days for a block type that has no interim deposit.
- The refund-on-cancellation setting reads No for every block type.
- The only place deposits are applied after the event is the group master account.

### Reading a row (hypothetical block)

A Wedding Room Block contracted for 120 room nights at a group rate of 200.00 USD has an anticipated room revenue of 120 times 200.00, that is 24,000.00 USD. Its signing deposit percentage of 10 corresponds to 2,400.00 USD, and its interim deposit falls due 120 calendar days before arrival. A Social Event Room Block with the same figures would show a signing deposit percentage of 15, corresponding to 3,600.00 USD, and an interim due date 90 calendar days before arrival.
